mindmap.title: System Error Logs
mindmap.description: This document contains technical logs regarding system failures. It details errors encountered while trying to load or generate content.

children.title: Resource Loading Errors
children.description: The system failed to load the resource for unit 1.pdf. This resulted in a 400 Bad Request status from the server.

children.title: Unit 1 PDF Failure
children.description: The server responded with a bad request status for this specific file. It could not be accessed at the provided URL.

children.title: Load Structure Failure
children.description: The function loadStructure failed within the MindMapControls file. It was triggered at line 79 of the JavaScript code.

children.title: Generation Failures
children.description: The process to generate a mind map failed to complete. This error occurred at the generation endpoint of the server.

children.title: MindMap Generation Error
children.description: The request to generate content failed with a status code 400. This prevented the mind map from being created.

children.title: File Execution Error
children.description: The error was caught in the MindMap.jsx file at line 41. It indicates an asynchronous operation failed to execute properly.

children.title: Technical Status Details
children.description: The logs report a specific AxiosError during the request process. Every recorded failure returned a status code of 400.

children.title: Bad Request Status
children.description: The server returned a 400 error for all attempted actions. This usually means the request sent by the client was invalid.

children.title: Axios Library Errors
children.description: The system used the Axios library to make web requests. These requests failed to reach or be processed by the server.
